section: Recent projects, acts and initiatives to reduce environmental pollution in India
subsections: Industrial clean-up tools - online monitoring, inventories

accepted.s: Which of the following pollutants is NOT tracked by the Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring System (CAAQMS)?
o: Particulate Matter 2.5
Methane
Ammonia
Sulphur dioxide
accepted.x: CAAQMS tracks PM2.5, PM10, SO2, NOx, CO, O3 and NH3. Methane is not included in the listed CAAQMS parameters.
accepted.tq: Find the one item that does not belong to the stated monitoring list.
accepted.sec: Industrial clean-up tools - online monitoring, inventories

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. CAAQMS tracks PM2.5 and PM10.
2. CAAQMS monitors sulphur dioxide, nitrogen oxides and carbon monoxide.
3. Ozone and ammonia are also among the pollutants tracked by CAAQMS.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
2 and 3 only
1 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The listed CAAQMS parameters are PM2.5, PM10, SO2, NOx, CO, O3 and NH3.
accepted.tq: Verify each statement against the complete list before selecting the inclusive option.
accepted.sec: Industrial clean-up tools - online monitoring, inventories

accepted.s: Which application provides public access to air-quality data generated through the monitoring system?
o: SAAP
SAMEER
BRAP
PARIVESH 3.0
accepted.x: Public access to the relevant air-quality data is provided through the SAMEER app.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the public-data application from portals, programmes and grants.
accepted.sec: Industrial clean-up tools - online monitoring, inventories

accepted.s: PARIVESH 3.0 is primarily designed as a:
o: single-window portal for clearances and compliance monitoring
grant scheme for strengthening Pollution Control Boards
programme for replacing BS-IV vehicles with BS-VI vehicles
mobile application for publishing air-quality readings
accepted.x: PARIVESH 3.0 functions as a single-window portal for environmental clearances and compliance monitoring.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise institutional function rather than the associated environmental programme.
accepted.sec: Industrial clean-up tools - online monitoring, inventories

accepted.s: Which one of the following is the appropriate application of Common Effluent Treatment Plants (CETPs)?
o: Issuing environmental clearances through a single window
Treatment of emissions from all thermal power stations
Monitoring of ambient air quality in major cities
Treatment of effluents generated by clusters of small industries
accepted.x: CETPs are intended for clusters of small industries, enabling common treatment of their effluents.
accepted.tq: Apply the facility to the industrial setting for which it is specifically intended.
accepted.sec: Industrial clean-up tools - online monitoring, inventories

accepted.s: The State Assistance for Abatement of Pollution (SAAP), introduced in 1992, provides grants primarily to:
o: strengthen Pollution Control Boards
finance Blue Flag certification of beaches
implement market-based carbon credits
establish international air-quality stations
accepted.x: SAAP, dating from 1992, provides grants to strengthen Pollution Control Boards.
accepted.tq: Link the scheme with its year and the institution it supports.
accepted.sec: Industrial clean-up tools - online monitoring, inventories

accepted.s: With regard to online continuous emission and effluent monitoring, which of the following statements is correct?
o: It is administered by the State Assistance for Abatement of Pollution without CPCB involvement.
It is voluntary for all industries but compulsory only for municipal bodies.
It applies exclusively to industries producing household solid waste.
It is compulsory for highly polluting industries belonging to the 17-category classification.
accepted.x: The CPCB made online continuous emission and effluent monitoring compulsory for highly polluting industries in the 17-category classification.
accepted.tq: Use the authority, target group and compulsory nature together to identify the correct statement.
accepted.sec: Industrial clean-up tools - online monitoring, inventories

accepted.s: India implemented BS-VI emission standards from:
o: 1 April 2019
1 April 2020
1 April 2021
1 April 2018
accepted.x: BS-VI emission standards came into force in India from 1 April 2020.
accepted.tq: Select the exact date from closely spaced chronological distractors.
accepted.sec: Industrial clean-up tools - online monitoring, inventories

accepted.s: The Environmental (Protection) Fund Rules referred to in the recent environmental initiatives are associated with the year:
accepted.x: The relevant Environmental (Protection) Fund Rules are the 2026 Rules.
accepted.tq: Use the exact year attached to the named legal instrument.

accepted.s: Which of the following concerns has been raised in debates relating to recent environmental regulatory changes?
o: The prohibition of clean fuels and eco-labelling.
The replacement of all Pollution Control Boards by local bodies.
Decriminalisation and relaxed green-belt norms may weaken deterrence.
The complete abolition of all environmental clearances for industries.
accepted.x: The debates include concerns that decriminalisation and relaxed green-belt norms could reduce deterrence. The other alternatives do not represent the stated concerns.
accepted.tq: Identify the genuine criticism rather than an extreme or absolute claim.

accepted.s: The expression 'ex-post facto environmental clearances' refers to clearances that are:
o: obtained before a project is proposed
issued only for projects outside green-belt areas
given automatically through the BRAP portal
granted after the project or activity has already commenced
accepted.x: Ex-post facto clearances are granted after the relevant project or activity has already begun, making them a subject of environmental debate.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a clearance granted after commencement from prior approval.

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched in the context of Andhra Pradesh's environmental initiatives?
o: APPCB — siting guidelines; BRAP — single-window system
APPCB — NAAQS formulation; BRAP — CETP construction
APPCB — Blue Flag certification; BRAP — ozone monitoring
APPCB — Environmental Protection Fund Rules; BRAP — SAAP grants
accepted.x: APPCB is associated with siting guidelines, while BRAP is associated with a single-window system. The other pairings assign unrelated functions to these bodies or initiatives.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure institutional-function pair and eliminate swapped responsibilities.

accepted.s: Which one of the following best expresses the significance of the emerging approach to industrial pollution control?
o: A shift from end-of-pipe control towards prevention through clean fuels, eco-labels and market credits
A policy of replacing compliance monitoring with voluntary disclosure alone
A restriction of pollution control measures to large industries only
A shift from prevention towards exclusive dependence on end-of-pipe treatment
accepted.x: The emerging approach moves beyond end-of-pipe control towards prevention, including clean fuels, eco-labels and market credits.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct direction of policy change and its associated instruments.
